NKE.summary: Reports tonight against a low bar. The stock sits near a 12-year low and was downgraded to Underperform days before the print, but tariff costs cap the upside on margins.
points: Consensus near $11.3B revenue and $0.44 EPS, against $11.7B and $0.49 a year ago.
Management guided revenue down low-to-mid single digits with gross margin slightly positive.
Incremental tariff costs now estimated at about $1.5B a year, up from about $1B; last quarter's tariff recovery does not repeat.

sources.title: Nike announces Q1 FY2027 earnings date (Barchart)

APLD.summary: A history of very large beats against a consensus that has drifted lower, but the stock moves about 14% on reports and the current market read is bearish.
points: Beat EPS estimates in 7 of the last 8 reports; last quarter's revenue came in far above estimates.
Consensus for the quarter is a loss of about $0.20 to $0.30 a share on roughly $115M revenue.
Options price a move a little smaller than the stock usually makes.

sources.title: Applied Digital beat estimates by 61% last quarter (TIKR)

PEP.summary: An easy comparison against a soft Q3 2025, but management has pointed to the low end of full-year guidance. A small mover.
points: Consensus about $25.0B revenue (+4.9%) and $2.28 EPS (+0.6%).
Full-year guide: organic revenue +2% to +4%, core constant-currency EPS +4% to +6%, likely at the low end.
Typical reaction about 4%, and options price about the same.

DAL.summary: Guidance is solid and the beat record strong. Fuel prices are the main swing factor for the outlook, which usually moves the stock more than the quarter itself.
points: Q3 guide: EPS $2.00 to $2.50 on revenue up mid-teens percent.
Full-year adjusted EPS guide of $6.50 to $7.50 affirmed.
Options price about the stock's typical 7% move.

UAL.summary: Guidance was cut in July and the Q3 range is wide. The model sees no edge either way.
points: Q3 EPS guide $2.50 to $3.50 against a $3.18 consensus at the time.
Full-year EPS outlook lowered from $9 to $11.

AAL.summary: The weakest of the three big airlines: strong revenue growth still comes with an expected adjusted loss, and guidance has been cut.
points: Q3 outlook: revenue up 16% to 19% with an adjusted loss.
Full-year EPS guide cut to -$0.65 to +$0.65.

sources.title: American Airlines posts 88% profit drop in Q2 (InsideFlyer)

JPM.summary: Management has already pointed to strong investment banking and markets revenue. Options are expensive against the stock's small typical move, so buying calls has a poor record.
points: Expects Q3 investment banking fees and markets revenue up mid-to-high teens percent year over year.
Some quarter-to-date capital markets indicators reportedly tracked below expectations across the industry.
Typical reaction only about 2.6%.

sources.title: JPMorgan expects Q3 IB fees and markets revenue to rise (Pulse 2.0)
Wall Street's biggest banks are riding high as earnings season begins

C.summary: Benefits from the same capital markets backdrop as its peers, with a more balanced business mix. The model lean is mild.
points: Analysts expect investment banking and trading to grow for a seventh straight quarter at most large banks.
Large-bank profits expected up about 6% year over year.

sources.title: US banks to reap bigger profits as deals rebound (Gazette)

WFC.summary: Less exposed to the investment banking rebound than its peers, so its results lean on lending and deposits.
points: Has a smaller, younger Wall Street division than the other large banks.
Options price about the stock's typical move.

sources.title: US banks to reap bigger profits as deals rebound (Gazette)

MS.summary: The model's strongest lean. Wealth management cushions any softness in deals and trading.
points: Beat record and estimate revisions are both strong.
Among the most exposed to investment banking and trading, so a softer quarter-to-date tape is the risk.

sources.title: Investment banking surge: Morgan Stanley solidifies Wall Street revival
Wall Street's biggest banks are riding high as earnings season begins

BAC.summary: Beat estimates in all of the last 8 reports and net interest income is guided higher. The stock fell about 14% over the past month, which lowers the bar.
points: 2026 net interest income growth guided at 6% to 8%, with the CFO pointing to the upper end.
Typical reaction only about 2%; out-of-the-money calls would have lost money after all of the last 8 reports.

sources.title: BofA CFO expects NII at upper end of 6-8% guidance (Newsquawk)

TSM.summary: Guidance implies very strong growth, and monthly sales reports usually reveal most of the revenue line before the call. The risk is the stock's reaction after a 10% run-up.
points: Q3 revenue guide $44.6B to $45.8B, gross margin 65% to 67%.
Raised its 2026 growth forecast to over 40% in US dollar terms.
September sales are due around Oct 10, before the report.

sources.title: TSMC forecasts 2026 revenue growth over 40% (KuCoin News)

ASML.view: Bullish on results, mixed on reaction
ASML.summary: Guidance was raised in July and estimates are up 26% in 90 days. But the stock fell after 4 of its last 8 beats; bookings and 2027 commentary drive the reaction.
points: Q3 guide: sales EUR 11.0B to 12.0B, gross margin 55% to 57%.
2026 sales guide raised to EUR 43B to 45B.

LRCX.summary: Guided well above consensus in July on memory and AI demand, and options price about a normal move. One of the cleaner setups on the list, though its options cost more than the per-trade budget.
points: September-quarter guide: revenue $8.1B plus or minus $0.4B and EPS $2.15 plus or minus $0.15, roughly 14% and 18% above consensus at the time.
Raised its 2026 wafer fab equipment outlook to the low $150B range.

sources.title: Lam Research Q4 earnings call highlights (MarketBeat)

UNH.summary: The July beat and guidance raise reset expectations higher, and medical cost trend is still the swing factor. Options price a smaller move than usual.
points: Q2 adjusted EPS of $6.38 beat by about $1.50; full-year guide raised to $19.50 to $20.
Commercial medical cost trend remains above the roughly 11% assumption, and Medicaid margins stay pressured.

sources.title: UnitedHealth gets a clean bill of health (Briefing.com)

CLF.summary: Q3 was guided to more than double on higher steel prices, and options price a smaller move than the stock usually makes. One of the few names where options look cheap.
points: Q3 adjusted EBITDA guide about $575M, against $286M in Q2 (its best quarter in two years).
Average selling price rose to $1,124 a ton as Section 232 tariffs and tight supply lift US steel prices.

sources.title: Cleveland-Cliffs offers bright Q3 2026 outlook (Manufacturing Dive)

EQT.summary: Production is strong but weak natural gas prices hold back earnings; realised prices will decide the quarter.
points: Q3 sales volume guide 570 to 620 Bcfe; full-year volume guidance raised.
NYMEX gas averaged $2.89 last quarter against $3.43 a year earlier.

GM.summary: Guidance has been raised twice this year and tariff costs revised lower, while options price a smaller move than usual.
points: 2026 adjusted EBIT guide raised to $14B to $16B and adjusted EPS to $12 to $14.
Gross tariff impact cut to $3.5B to $4.5B.

sources.title: General Motors raises 2026 adjusted EBIT and EPS guidance (Nasdaq)

NFLX.summary: Q3 guidance implied slower growth and the stock is down about 18% over the past month. The model sees no clear edge.
points: Q3 guide: revenue up 12% (11% at constant currency) with a 33.2% operating margin.
Consensus EPS about $0.82; estimates slipped 2% over 90 days.

IBM.summary: Revenue growth slowed sharply last quarter on lumpy infrastructure deals while software held up. Options look a little expensive.
points: Q2 revenue growth slowed to about 1%; software annual recurring revenue reached $24.6B, up 8%.
Full-year revenue growth guide of 4% to 5% maintained, with software at 6% to 8%.

T.summary: A steady reporter that rose after 7 of its last 8 reports, but options price about 1.4 times its usual move, so calls have rarely paid.
points: Beat EPS estimates in 7 of the last 8 reports.
Fiber and wireless bundling has driven recent subscriber growth.

TSLA.summary: The weakest setup on the list: a poor recent beat record, estimates cut sharply and thin margins. The stock trades on narrative, so the reaction can ignore the numbers.
points: Consensus EPS was cut about 19% over 90 days, with 15 downward revisions in the last month.
Q3 delivery estimates of about 461K to 470K compare with 480K in Q2. Tesla usually reports deliveries in the first days of October, before earnings.
Options price a smaller move than the stock usually makes.

sources.title: Tesla's earnings setup: most of the good news is already out (Nasdaq)

CMCSA.summary: The CFO has already warned that broadband losses will be worse than a year ago, which lowers the bar but keeps sentiment weak.
points: Q3 broadband subscriber losses expected to exceed the 91K lost in Q3 2025, blamed on low-priced fiber competition.
Management still expects a better full year for broadband losses.

sources.title: Comcast expecting more broadband losses than last year for Q3 (Broadband Breakfast)

F.summary: Estimates have risen sharply (14 upward revisions against 1 down) after a July beat and guidance raise, and the stock fell about 14% over the past month.
points: Q2 adjusted EPS of $0.42 beat the $0.35 forecast; full-year adjusted EBIT guide raised to $10B to $11B.
US sales were down 9.6% in the first half on production disruption; net tariff cost about $1B for the year.

FCX.summary: Record copper prices help, but the Grasberg bottleneck limits volumes for the rest of the year.
points: Q2 EPS of $0.68 beat $0.60 on a realised copper price of $6.17/lb, against $4.54 a year earlier.
Grasberg output limited to about 60,000 t/d in the second half, against a prior 100,000 t/d target.

sources.title: Freeport beats profit forecasts despite Grasberg slump (Mining.com)

INTC.summary: Guided well above consensus in July and estimates have caught up, but the stock is up about 33% in 20 days, so a beat may already be priced in.
points: Q3 guide: EPS $0.38 (consensus was $0.24) on revenue of $15.8B to $16.8B.
30 upward and no downward estimate revisions in the last 30 days.

NOK.summary: The business is improving on AI and optical demand, but the model's bearish lean comes from weak price action. Options price more than the stock's usual move.
points: Q2 Network Infrastructure sales up 12%, with sales to AI and cloud customers up 105%.
Expects full-year comparable operating profit somewhat above the midpoint of EUR 2.0B to 2.5B.
